Thanks, {{author}}. This is the place for ideas and questions, so I can't take this one here. Where it belongs:

- A security concern: please don't post details in public. Use [kombify.io/security](https://kombify.io/security) or e-mail [info@kombify.io](mailto:info@kombify.io).
- A bug in an open-source kombify product: open the bug form in that product's repository, for example [StackKits](https://github.com/kombifyio/stackKits/issues/new/choose), [Techstack](https://github.com/kombifyio/TechStack/issues/new/choose) or [SpeechKit](https://github.com/kombifyio/SpeechKit/issues/new/choose).
- Your kombify account, a subscription or a hosted product: [kombify.io/support](https://kombify.io/support) or [info@kombify.io](mailto:info@kombify.io).

If you think this belongs here after all, reply and a person will look again.
